desc: An elderly man in a tweed waistcoat and bow tie sits at a table in a hall full of onlookers, handling a painted porcelain vase in white cotton gloves. He sets it down on the table, looks up at the couple sitting opposite and tells them what he has found while the crowd of older visitors behind him leans in, mouths open.

desc: A couple pose side by side in a white panelled room next to a potted olive tree, changing outfits between shots. They start in matching light blue: she in a light blue satin shirt tied at the waist with white trousers and a light blue bag, he in a light blue linen shirt with white trousers. Then she wears a blue draped top with brown flared trousers while he wears a brown polo with light blue trousers, then both are in chocolate brown and cream, and finally both wear dark green cable-knit jumpers, hers over a camel skirt with tall suede boots, his with camel chinos.
said: Remember, light blue with white looks good, but light blue with brown is unbeatable. Chocolate with cream looks luxurious and forest green with camel looks next level.

desc: In a bright kitchen a young chef in a blue apron runs a long knife through a white onion on a wooden board, leaving a heap of onion rings. Cut to a garden table where an older man in a grey polo presses a knife down through a whole watermelon until the green rind splits in two. Then a bearded man in a checked shirt swings an axe into a big log on a woodpile and it splits open. Finally a woman standing in a huge orange pumpkin in a field raises a long blade over her head and brings it down, and the pumpkin lies open in two seedy halves on the grass.

desc: A postman in a bright red high-visibility uniform and red cap wheels a red bicycle along a street of English terraced houses; a red bag stuffed with letters hangs from the handlebars. He pushes a bundle of letters through the letter slot of a red front door, knocks on the door, waves to a woman watering her front garden, hands a wrapped birthday parcel over a brick garden wall to a resident, then rides off smiling at the camera.
